title: TEST CARD: feedwater flow control FICFW1007 — force manual M.0228

scenarios.title: Cold start: FICFW1007 is forced to MANUAL
scenarios.drawing: M.0228 = OR( NOT LICBR1001B.MAN (DRUM LEVEL CONTROL MANUAL FOR START-UP), BFWP A (M.3343) and B (M.3344) both stopped, SIG.AB B.0689·B.0640 / B.068A·B.0642, M.022E ). M.022E = OR( TON 60 s of M.022C = BOILER MAIN STEAM FLOW < 100 T/H, SIG.AB ). M.0228 is 1:B of the FICFW1007 A/M T switch (force manual).

steps.why: cold start: no BFWP running, start-up level control not in MANUAL, steam flow < 100 T/H
AUTO not allowed while force is active

scenarios.title: Permissives made: start-up control in MANUAL, BFWP A running, steam flow above 100 T/H for 60 s: force clears
scenarios.drawing: All OR inputs of M.0228 at 0: LICBR1001B.MAN = 1 (operator presses M on LICBR1001B), M.3343 = 1, FIQMS1031.PV above 100 T/H (AI0129 on ABC-001C; > 100: M.022C = 0, the TON 60 s output drops). The A/M T switch holds the MANUAL leg: the operator selects AUTO.

steps.say: LICBR1001B: press M (start-up drum level control to MANUAL)
Main steam flow transmitter AI0129 (ABC-001C) = 200 T/H

scenarios.title: In AUTO, both BFWP stop: FICFW1007 trips to MANUAL
scenarios.drawing: M.3343 = 0 and M.3344 = 0: the AND of the two NOTs is 1, M.0228 = 1, the A/M T switch goes to B (MANUAL) at once.

steps.say: Main steam flow transmitter AI0129 = 200 T/H
